chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluyah (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Al-Sayyari, linking it up through his chain to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
that he was asked about the lowest of the people, so he said: 'They are those who drink wine and play the tanbur.'

key_terms.السُّفْلَةِ: The lowest or most base people

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the lowest people according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifying the 'sufala' (lowly people) by their indulgence in wine and the tanbur, linking sensory intoxication and musical entertainment to spiritual degradation. This hadith highlights the Shia scholarly view that these practices dull the heart's perception of divine truth, serving as practical markers of a soul detached from spiritual refinement.
